Sum of products and product of sums forms

Source: R/logic.R
SOPform.Rd

SOPform(vars, minterms) and POSform(vars, minterms) build minimal disjunctive and conjunctive forms from the rows where the function is true, with SymPy's Quine-McCluskey reduction. A row is an integer (most significant variable first), a vector of bits, or a named list giving the values of some variables (the others take every value).

Usage

SOPform(vars, minterms, dontcares = integer())

POSform(vars, minterms, dontcares = integer())

Arguments

vars

A list of symbols.

minterms

Rows where the function is true: an integer vector, or a list of integers, bit vectors and named lists.

dontcares

Rows whose value does not matter, in the same forms.

Value

A boolean expression.

Examples

w <- Symbol("w"); x <- Symbol("x"); y <- Symbol("y"); z <- Symbol("z")
SOPform(list(w, x, y, z), c(1, 3, 7, 11, 15), dontcares = c(0, 2, 5))
#> (y & z) | (~w & ~x)
